description: Four units of a stereo core frame and a lossless extension of a 5.1 channel set whose frame has the word 0xF14000D1 that FFmpeg reads as DTS:X IMAX and MediaInfo as DTS:X after its band data.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
